links.source_location: three copies of the same neon icon live in assets/icons, design/exports and src/Monocle.App/Assets; which one is canonical and which are stale copies is not determinable from the files alone
the mascot's right eye is drawn as a magnifier/monocle, punning on the product name Monocle
#04211e strokes on #1eb5a6 ground - the palette inverted
#2ee6cf strokes on #121814 - the brightened neon end of the same teal family
filter="url(#neon-glow)" on the stroke group and on the antenna tip circle
the glow only reads because the stroke colour was pushed from #1eb5a6 to the brighter #2ee6cf against a near-black ground
rasterisation of the neon SVG at 480px for Avalonia, which cannot render the SVG filter directly
catalog replaces the paste-a-path scan bar
the AI critic with a moustache
identical render; the App copy is the design export vendored into the Avalonia asset folder
same mascot geometry; neon variant adds the glow filter, thins strokes to 3.4 and drops the filled monocle pupil
Scan first for metrics; Process runs the ticked models
byte-identical markup: same 120x120 viewBox, #121814 ground, #2ee6cf 3.4pt strokes, neon-glow filter
identical path geometry; the two differ only by inverted palette (teal ground/dark ink vs charcoal ground/teal ink) and stroke width 5 vs 4.5
